SELECT c.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, c.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr,
a.VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, '' AS lastPeriod, a.CLOSE_PRICE AS cloPrice, a.AVERAGE_PRICE AS avgPrice, a.BUY_ONE_PRICE AS buyOnePrice, a.SELL_ONE_PRICE AS sellOnePrice, a.MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, a.MIN_PRICE AS minPrice,
a.CLOSE_PRICE_FULL AS cloPriceFull, a.AVERAGE_PRICE_FULL AS avgPriceFull, a.BUY_ONE_PRICE_FULL AS buyOnePriceFull, a.SELL_ONE_PRICE_FULL AS sellOnePriceFull, a.MAX_PRICE_FULL AS maxPriceFull, a.MIN_PRICE_FULL AS minPriceFull
FROM mst_BOND_MARKET_INFO a
INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.SEC_ID=c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND c.FINPROD_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{finprodId},'%')
AND c.FINPROD_ABBR like concat_ws('','%',#{finprodAbbr},'%')
AND a.VALUE_SOURCE = #{valueSource}
AND a.VALUE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND a.VALUE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
